text_sanskrit: उपद्रष्टानुमन्ता च भर्ता भोक्ता महेश्वरः । परमात्मेति चाप्युक्तो देहेऽस्मिन्पुरुषः परः ॥ १३-२३ ॥
itrans: upadraShTAnumantA cha bhartA bhoktA maheshvaraH . paramAtmeti chApyukto dehe.asminpuruShaH paraH .. 13-23 ..
translation: Paramatman (the supreme intelligence), the omnipotent Lord, is the Providence that impels, the most exalted witness, the support, enjoying the good essence of all action; so, He is called Purusha and He is even declared to be in this body and is far different (from it).
